interpretation.rpath: Full copied bundle retains Server -> ../Frameworks/libstreamer.dylib relative resolution; static compatibility only, not observed copy loading.
interpretation.agentArgument: -agent is confirmed by original LaunchAgent ProgramArguments. Other option-looking substring hits are not validated command-line arguments.
interpretation.launchChain: Original launchd user agent -> original Service -> original Server is observed. Service has NSTask/executableURL/launchServer-related substring clues; it is not proven to choose the Server from its own copied bundle.
interpretation.ipc: User agent registers fixed com.uuremote.agent.controlled/controller names. Original root daemon has fixed original application path strings. A copy in the same bootstrap namespace can conflict or use original peers; exact behavior unverified.
interpretation.signing: Ad-hoc changes code identity and does not preserve vendor Team ID. Runtime plus allow-DYLD and disable-LV on each actual instrumented host is a proposed local diagnostic condition, not an observed result.
interpretation.tcc: Re-signing changes identity; original screen-recording/Accessibility consent must not be assumed inherited. Precise reauthorization behavior remains untested.
interpretation.isolation: A copied bundle isolates files only; it may still share account, preferences, network identity, Mach services, and root-daemon IPC.
